svg.text: Blue: 40 solver replicas, seeds 21-60 (fresh runs). Orange: one saved COMSOL realization. Each replica starts with the same 287 particles.
Active curves use common saved times. Shading is empirical replica min/max, not a confidence or simultaneous95% band.
Lines connect saved observations for display.
Lines connect saved observations for display.
Histogram bin widths: 5us and5 particles, for display only, not agreement gates. Histogram heights count whole-cohort replicas.
Native disappearance cause stays unknown; it is not relabeled escape. Numerical capture is not certified physical adhesion.
The weak-limit model, field-transfer and finite-step limitations remain. No individual stochastic trajectory is used as a matching gate.
